sentences.en: Leo started to roar when he was two years old.
sentences.zh: 利奥两岁的时候就开始咆哮了。

sentences.en: In the moutain lives a tiger which lost its roar.
sentences.zh: 在山里住着一只失去了吼叫能力的老虎。

sentences.en: If the thunder isn't roaring, the peasant won't cross himself.
sentences.zh: 如果雷声没有轰鸣，农民就不会画十字。

phrases.zh: 观众发出震耳欲聋的欢呼声
